news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS in line with analyst expectations despite revenue beat
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹46.46 (up from ₹35.18 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹10.8b (up 36% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹5.03b (up 33% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 46% (down from 48% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.7%. Earnings per share (EPS) were mostly in line with analyst estimates. Revenue is forecast to grow 19% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 15% growth forecast for the Diversified Financial industry in India.

news.title: INDIASHLTR: Upcoming Dividend Decision Will Support Bullish Long Term View
news.body: Analysts have kept the fair value estimate for India Shelter Finance steady at ₹1,002.63, citing only very small tweaks to assumptions such as the discount rate and future P/E that do not materially alter the overall price target view. What's in the News A board meeting will be held on May 2, 2026 to consider and approve the audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026, and to consider a final dividend on equity shares for that period (company filing).

news.title: India Shelter Finance Corporation Limited Recommends Final Dividend for the Financial Year Ended March 31, 2026
news.body: India Shelter Finance Corporation Limited, at the board meeting held on May 02, 2026 the Board of Directors has recommended a final dividend of INR 10 per equity share (200% of face value), for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, subject To Approve the shareholders at the upcoming Annual General Meeting of the Company.

news.title: INDIASHLTR: Board Meeting And Planned NCD Issuance Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on India Shelter Finance from ₹1,015.14 to ₹1,002.63 as small tweaks to the discount rate and assumed future P/E more than offset largely unchanged growth and margin assumptions. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for February 7, 2026 at 10:00 Indian Standard Time to review and adopt unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025 (company filing).

news.title: INDIASHLTR: Upcoming Board Meeting And NCD Plans Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on India Shelter Finance from ₹1,072.20 to ₹1,015.14, citing updated assumptions that reflect a lower discount rate, slightly adjusted revenue growth expectations, improved profit margin and a reduced future P/E multiple. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on February 7, 2026, at 10:00 Indian Standard Time to review and adopt unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025 (company filing).
